description: Thirst Was Reclaimed adds a thirst bar beside hunger.

pages.title: Thirst
pages.text:
Thirst Was Reclaimed adds a thirst bar beside hunger. It drains as you play, and with nothing to drink you eventually die of dehydration.

There is also a hidden buffer called **quenched**, like saturation for drinks. A good drink fills it.

pages.title: How to drink
pages.text:
- **Rain:** stand in it and look straight up.
- **By hand:** both hands empty, crouch and right-click water.
- **Bottles:** fill a glass bottle at any water and hold right-click to drink.

New here? [#](2E5AAC)[Your First Days](entry://start_here/first_days)[#]() has the short version.

pages.title: Dirty water
pages.text:
Water has a purity: **Dirty**, Slightly Dirty, Acceptable, Purified. Still water at sea level is Dirty: it always makes you sick and sometimes poisons you. Slightly Dirty is a coin flip. Acceptable and Purified are safe.

Bottles, buckets and bowls of water all carry a purity.

pages.title: Boiling
pages.text:
Boiling raises purity one step at a time. In a campfire each cook gives one step. A furnace is faster: dirty water goes straight to Acceptable, and the next cook gives Purified.

It works on water bottles, water buckets and terracotta water bowls.

pages.title: Campfire
pages.text: Cooking water bottles, buckets and bowls here raises their purity one step per cook. Slow, but free.

pages.title: Sand Filter
pages.text: Pump dirty water in from the top, purified water out of the bottom, one step per pass. Recipe: sand over a Nozzle over a Fluid Tank.

pages.title: Create filter
pages.text: The Sand Filter is where thirst meets Create. You build it with a **Nozzle** and a **Fluid Tank** and run it with a [#](2E5AAC)[pump](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#](). It is the automatic way to supply a base.

pages.title: Terracotta Water Bowl
pages.text: A reusable bowl. Clay bowls bake into terracotta bowls, and a Spout fills one with 250 mB of water.

pages.title: Cactus and extras
pages.text:
A Create **Compacting** recipe squeezes a Cactus into purified water (250 mB) and green dye. Good for desert bases.

Fruits Delight juices count as drinks. Farmer's Delight melon juice and apple cider hydrate like a water bottle.

pages.title: Cold Sweat
pages.text:
Thirst and [#](2E5AAC)[Cold Sweat](entry://survival/temperature)[#]() work together. The [#](2E5AAC)[Waterskin](entry://survival/temperature_gear)[#]() carries a purity like a bottle, and a furnace or campfire purifies it the same way.

With Cold Sweat, thirst lost while healing follows your body temperature, not just the biome's.
